name: Total Commander
price: Shareware: EUR 42 + VAT per licence (students EUR 31.50), free updates; Android version free
engine: Lister: own image viewer, DirectShow media player; plugins (WLX) e.g. Imagine
summary: The best-known orthodox (two-panel) file manager for Windows, developed since 1993. It is strong on file operations, archives, FTP, multi-rename and directory sync, with the Lister viewer and plugins for images and media.
where_it_wins: Mature dual-pane file management: sync dirs, compare, multi-rename, checksums
Huge plugin ecosystem (Lister, packer, file system plugins)
Lister player switches subtitle/audio streams and speed
Runs on Windows from 95 to 11, plus a free Android app
where_schnellbild_wins: Native on macOS (Total Commander has no Mac version)
Free and open source, no shareware nag
Modern image formats (HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP) and MKV/WebM without plugins or codec packs
Photos and videos in one thumbnail grid with folder previews
Recursive slideshow with photos and videos mixed
App Sandbox, never goes online, provably built from public source

free.note: Shareware, 30-day trial; licence EUR 42 + VAT (students EUR 31.50). Android version is free.

native_apple_silicon.note: Windows only; vendor points Mac users to emulators or other commanders.

no_account_no_tracking.note: No account; vendor states no adware/spyware. Unregistered copies show a shareware reminder.

dark_light_setting.note: Dark mode since 9.50: always on, always off, or follow Windows.

languages_20.note: 19 languages in the installer, about 20 more as downloadable language files.

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnails view (Ctrl+Shift+F1) for files; folder preview images not documented.

recursive_search.note: Find Files across drives and subfolders, even inside archives.

network_shares_fast.note: Direct network neighbourhood access, thumbnail caching; no specific speed claims for shares.

multiple_windows.note: One main window with tabs; Lister can open in separate windows.

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/WebP/AVIF not shown by the built-in Lister; via plugin (Imagine) or IrfanView/Explorer preview handler.

img_raw.note: Built-in: RAW thumbnails from embedded EXIF previews. Full view via plugin.

img_svg_pdf.note: via plugin (Imagine: SVG; PDF needs another Lister plugin).

keyboard_paging.note: N / P in Lister step through the selected files.

zoom_rotate.note: Built-in image viewer zooms (Ctrl+wheel, +/-); rotation via plugin.

slideshow_recursive.note: No slideshow at all: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

auto_enhance_view.note: No view-only image adjustments (brightness/gamma) in Lister: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

file_info_exif.note: EXIF date via custom columns/multi-rename; full EXIF via plugin (Imagine).

wrong_extension_note.note: No content-vs-extension check: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

video_native.note: Lister DirectShow media player; formats depend on installed codecs.

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Needs DirectShow filters (LAV/ffdshow can be dropped into filter64 folder).

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Thumbnails view shows all files; non-image thumbnails come from Windows ("Explorer method"), so video thumbnails depend on installed handlers

video_skim_arrows.note: Ctrl/Shift+arrow keys fast forward/rewind; jump buttons 10 s / 60 s.

subtitles_embedded.note: Switch subtitle streams via context menu.

audio_track_choice.note: Switch audio streams via context menu.

control_bar_movable.note: Lister media player controls appear at the bottom (shown when the mouse moves to the bottom in full screen)

playlist.note: N / P steps through selected media files; .cue track lists; no playlist panel.

saved_playlists.note: No playlists: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

pip.note: No picture-in-picture: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

music_mode.note: Audio playback with tags and cover art in Lister.

streaming_urls.note: Lister media player plays local files; no stream/URL playback in the history

online_subtitles.note: No subtitle download: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

video_filters_enhance.note: Media player has speed, audio/subtitle stream choice, single step; no picture adjustments in the history

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Windows program; no Finder/Quick Look integration.

archives_as_folders.note: ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, GZ, CAB, ARJ, LZH, ACE and more, plus packer plugins.

comics_cbz_cbr.note: CBZ/CBR as archives; comic viewing via plugin (Imagine reads CBZ/CBR/CB7).

archive_passwords.note: Handles encrypted archives, including header-encrypted names.

split_archives.note: Opens/unpacks multi-volume RAR (via tc7z dll), ZIP and 7z archives; also Split/Combine tool for big files

videos_in_archives.note: Lister can view files inside archives (temporary extraction).

manga_two_page.note: No comic/manga or two-page mode: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

dual_pane.note: The reference implementation of F5 copy / F6 move.

undo_file_actions.note: Undo only in the multi-rename tool (multiple steps).

image_editing.note: Not built in; image plugins (Imagine) can rotate, resize, save.

batch_convert.note: Multi-rename tool yes; image conversion only via plugin.

library_catalog.note: File comments (descript.ion, comments view); no tags/ratings database.

cloud_sync.note: Built-in FTP/FTPS client; no cloud sync.

custom_shortcuts.note: Hotkeys via Configuration - Options - Misc, commands with parameters.

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Ships keyboard.txt (plain-text list of all keys) alongside the help; no designed printable sheet

boss_key.note: No boss key: not in the complete version history (history.txt, all versions up to 11.58.1)

app_sandbox.note: Windows program, no macOS App Sandbox.

no_network.note: Built-in FTP client, HTTP proxy support.

notarized_attested.note: Installer is code-signed (Ghisler Software GmbH); closed source, not reproducible.
